title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - TermsAndConditions
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/TermsAndConditions. Terms and Conditions applying to a service offering.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'TermsAndConditions'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

url.description: Property. A resolvable link to the terms & conditions document.

hash.description: Property. SHA-256 hash of the document.
